title: 第26章
content:
第4章《远方传来风笛》晚上回房间，温然特意站在房门口对比了一下，确认自己的卧室还没有顾昀迟家的玄关大。别墅应该是专门请设计师按顾昀迟的喜好装修的，冷淡又舒服的风格，没有因为面积过大而显得空旷冷清。洗完澡又做了一小时题，温然下楼倒水，正碰上陈舒茴和温睿一起回来，两人脸色都不太好，显然又争执过。温睿走过来挤开温然倒了杯水喝，温然想了想，又倒了一杯拿去给陈舒茴。“放着吧。”陈舒茴坐在沙发上看手机里的消息，温然将水杯放在茶几上，正要走，陈舒茴打着字问他，“今天去顾昀迟家怎么样？”温然说：“学到了很多知识。”陈舒茴抬起头看着他。他只好老实交代：“不怎么样。”“你这幅死气沉沉的样子，能怎么样就奇怪了。”陈舒茴又看了眼温睿，像抱怨又像自嘲，“没一个有用的。”她说着就起身上了楼，温睿不紧不慢摸出一根烟点上：“指望你去搞定顾昀迟，也不知道他们是怎么想的。”不理解他嘴里的“他们”具体指的是谁，这件事原本就是赶鸭子上架，温然问：“不然你去搞定他吗？”像自己一样，吃尽苦头植入人工腺体，带着温家对柏清集团资源和股份的觊觎，成为与顾昀迟拥有高匹配度的omega，无视对方的厌恶与冷漠，做一个没有眼色又低声下气的傻瓜——这样的苦差事，温然不认为温睿能做到。事实上也并不是能不能做到的问题，他从来没得选。与其认为当初将他直接盖章成温然是温家人对于夭折的小儿子的执念，不如说是一种先见之明，一切都像是预先写好的剧本。“我可做不来这种事，不过我倒是想看看你能怎么搞定顾昀迟。”温睿将烟头扔进垃圾桶，上楼。怎么搞定，现实是完全搞不定。去顾昀迟家的第四天，温然仍没从他那里得到任何眼神或话语，如果不是339和老师还会与他交流，他在顾昀迟家就等同于一团空气，一团每天只会说“早”和“再见，今天打扰你了”的扰人空气。连339都忍不住催他：“有没有可能其实你是NPC？怎么每天的任务和台词都是固定的，要不你找些别的话题呢？总不能一直这样下去吧！”“我在他面前变成一头驴他也不会理我的。”温然看开，“先就这样吧。”安静几秒，339问：“你真的能变成一头驴吗？”“……”早上补习结束，顾昀迟连午饭都没有吃，直接回了房间。他今天状态似乎不是特别好，上课有些没精神，而他没精神时的表情看起来格外不爽，导致温然一整个上午都战战兢兢。饭后温然和老师坐在沙发上休息看书，没过几分钟，两个医生拎着药箱走进客厅，老师对此习以为常的样子，说：“他在房间。”医生便点点头，和339一起上了楼。下午的补习只剩温然，老师给他上完课之后就先离开了：“昀迟今天应该没办法上课了，那剩下的时间你自己看书做题，有什么问题的话下周一问我。”“好，老师慢走。”独自学了近一小时，温然逐渐心不在焉，在想顾昀迟——他担心顾昀迟是不是因为心情不好而憋出了什么病，如果属实，那自己才是真的活不过今晚。乱七八糟地想着，门被轻轻敲了几下，弹开，339端着果汁：“下午好，要来一杯清爽的夏日饮品吗？”它移到温然面前，温然接过果汁，犹豫片刻，问：“他身体不舒服吗？”“嗯呢，老毛病了，时不时就这样，头晕发烧情绪焦躁。”温然语气谨慎：“是易感期吗？”“不是哦，比易感期症状轻多了，就是单纯的犯病了。”

339说，“医生也没有办法，只能给吃一点抑制剂和药缓解一下，主要还是靠他自己熬过去。”这个“熬”字顿时将程度加得很深，看温然被唬住了，339顺水推舟：“你要不要去看看他呢？他现在在床上昏迷，没有人陪，怪孤单的。”“医生走了吗？”“走了，一般没有特殊状况的话，基本是让他安静休息。”温然说：“那我还是不要去打扰他了吧。”“万一他想喝水，或者需要擦汗呢？”339放下托盘，展示了一下自己僵硬的机械手臂，“我的手不够柔软灵活，上次喂他水的时候不小心倒他脸上了，被骂死。”话已至此，温然只好合上书本，在339的带领下去了顾昀迟房外。忐忑地打开房门，目之所及是漆黑一片，房间里的信息素浓度应该很高，只是温然感知不到，能闻到的只有淡淡的香氛。无声无息的，339在背后像鬼一样悄悄把房门关上了，光线变得更暗，温然小心翼翼绕过隔断，房间太大，只能用望的——窗帘缝隙中漏进来的那道光打在床尾，深灰色床单，顾昀迟动也不动地躺着。走到床边才听见呼吸声，不太安稳也有点沉。眼睛渐渐适应黑暗，温然俯身去看，顾昀迟整个人趴着，枕头托着他白皙的侧脸和凌乱的头发，凑得近了，温然几乎能感受到他身上散发的热量。因为多年前的一场意外，顾昀迟的信息素变得尤其金贵，对omega的信息素也格外挑剔，无限趋于无感和免疫，更糟糕的是他只能使匹配度超过95%的omega怀孕。作为顾培闻最宠爱最重视的独孙，顾昀迟自然无法逃脱子嗣传承的命运，顾家一直在为他寻找高契合度omega——这是温然所了解到的全部信息。其余的，关于温家是如何发现这个被顾家隐藏的秘密，又如何拿到顾昀迟的信息素报告，温然无从得知，他也是今天才知道顾昀迟的身体还存在这种问题，s级们体质条件天生优越，连易感期都罕见，他却要隔三差五生这样的病，这何尝不是一种倒大霉。床边放着药和水杯，温然思考几秒，手腕微微抖着，伸进了顾昀迟的被子里。抓住了——是温然被抓住了。那只掌心滚烫的手猛地扣住他的手臂，力道惊人，温然还没来得及反应，就在昏暗中对上了顾昀迟睁开的眼，一瞬间头皮发麻。赶在顾昀迟认为他是想趁病爬床这个惊悚念头产生之前，温然语无伦次地道明意图：“不是……我是想帮你摘手环，摘掉了应该会舒服一点。”顾昀迟厌烦地甩开他的手，换了个睡姿，朝另一面侧躺，将摘下来的手环扔到被子上。失去手环的制约，信息素更肆无忌惮地散发，温然依旧是闻不到一点，但又奇怪地感觉到自己的腺体隐约在发热，也许是太紧张。“你要喝水吗？”温然想起339的嘱托，轻声问，“要擦汗吗？”没有回答，也不能再问下去了，顾昀迟连鼻息都透着不耐烦。温然闭上嘴，腺体似乎真的在发热，他想摸一摸，手贴上去才想到还戴着颈环，腺体是没摸到，指腹却不知碰到了颈环上的哪个触控按键，发出嘀的一声。温然顿时定住，立在原地静观其变了近一分钟，没有发生任何可怕的事，反倒听出顾昀迟的呼吸声变得轻而均匀，仿佛安稳地入睡了。又等了几分钟，确定顾昀迟是睡着了，温然拿起床头柜上的体温计，轻轻伸到他耳边，测了一下耳温，还在发烧。想了想，温然决定留下来，每隔一小时给顾昀迟测一次温度。他是有私心的，339看起来和顾培闻助理那边联系很紧密，说不定会将这件事也汇报过去，自己即使多此一举，也比冷眼旁观无动于衷来得好——顾昀迟和顾培闻，总要讨好一个。整个下午，温然靠坐在房门后，到点了便准时爬起来为顾昀迟测耳温，最后一次测量时数值已经接近正常，温然松口气，重新坐回去，想着稍微休息一下，一闭上眼却直接睡着。醒来时房间里有光亮，看亮度应该是床头灯。温然打开手机看了眼，居然已经晚上八点，而房间里正响起脚步声，不等他从地上爬起，顾昀迟已经站在两米外的位置，表情不明地盯着他。温然听到了四天以来顾昀迟对他说的第一句话：“还不走？”“啊？”刚睡醒，反应迟缓，温然回想了一下才说，“我担心你啊，你一直发烧。”“跟你有关系？”“因为我在你家补习，不能这么没有良心。”温然看不太清他的脸色，只能问，“你好点了吗？”“关你什么事。”顾昀迟说着转过身往洗手间走，去洗澡，抬手就脱身上的黑色T恤，腰和背随着衣摆上移而暴露，肌肉线条在光影下像画功出众的素描。“等等！”

Chapter 4 "Bagpipes from afar" After returning to the room at night, Wen Ran deliberately stood at the door of the room and compared it, confirming that his bedroom was not as big as the entrance hall of Gu Yunchi's house.The villa should have been specially decorated by a designer according to Gu Yunchi's preferences. It has a cold and comfortable style and does not look empty and deserted because of its large area.After taking a shower and doing questions for an hour, Wen Ran went downstairs to pour water, and met Chen Shuhui and Wen Rui coming back together. Both of them looked bad, and they had obviously argued again.Wen Rui came over and squeezed Wen Ran away and poured a glass of water. Wen Ran thought for a while, poured another glass and gave it to Chen Shuhui."Leave it alone." Chen Shuhui sat on the sofa and read the messages on the phone. Wen Ran put the water cup on the coffee table and was about to leave when Chen Shuhui typed and asked him, "How about going to Gu Yunchi's house today?" Wen Ran said, "I learned a lot." Chen Shuhui raised her head and looked at him.He had no choice but to confess honestly: "It's not that good." "It's strange what you can do with your lifeless look." Chen Shuhui looked at Wen Rui again, complaining and mocking herself, "None of it is useful." She got up and went upstairs. Wen Rui slowly took out a cigarette and lit it: "I hope you can deal with Gu Yunchi, I don't know what they think." She didn't understand who the "they" in his mouth specifically meant., this matter was originally just a matter of chasing ducks to the shelves, Wen Ran asked: "Why don't you go and get him?" Like himself, he went through all kinds of hardships to implant artificial glands, and with the Wen family's coveting of the resources and shares of the Baiqing Group, he became an omega who was highly compatible with Gu Yunchi, ignoring the other's disgust and indifference, and being a lookless and groveling fool - such a hard job, Wen Ran didn't think Wen Rui could do it.In fact, it wasn't a question of whether he could do it or not. He never had a choice.Instead of thinking that directly stamping him as Wen Ran was the Wen family's obsession with their youngest son who died in infancy, it is better to say that it was a kind of foresight, and everything seemed to be a pre-written script."I can't do this kind of thing, but I want to see how you can deal with Gu Yunchi." Wen Rui threw the cigarette butt into the trash can and went upstairs.How to do it, the reality is that it is completely impossible to do it.On the fourth day at Gu Yunchi's house, Wen Ran still didn't get any looks or words from him. If 339 and the teacher hadn't communicated with him, he would have been like a ball of air at Gu Yunchi's house, a disturbing air where he only said "good morning" and "goodbye, I've bothered you today" every day.Even 339 couldn't help but urge him: "Is it possible that you are actually an NPC? Why are the daily tasks and lines fixed? Why don't you find other topics? We can't keep going like this!" "He won't pay attention to me if I turn into a donkey in front of him." Wen Ran looked away, "Let's leave it at that." After a few seconds of silence, 339 asked: "Can you really turn into a donkey?" "..." After the morning tutoring session, Gu Yunchi went back to the room without even eating lunch.He didn't seem to be in particularly good condition today. He was a little lackluster in class, and his expression looked particularly unhappy when he was low energy, which caused Wen Ran to be trembling all morning.After the meal, Wen Ran and the teacher sat on the sofa to rest and read. Within a few minutes, two doctors walked into the living room carrying medicine boxes. The teacher looked accustomed to this and said, "He is in the room." The doctor nodded and went upstairs with 339.Wen Ran was the only one left with tutoring in the afternoon. The teacher left after giving him a lesson: "Eventually, I won't be able to attend class today. In the rest of the time, you can read and do questions by yourself. If you have any questions, ask me next Monday." "Okay, sir.Master, go slowly." After studying alone for nearly an hour, Wen Ran gradually became distracted, thinking about Gu Yunchi - he was worried that Gu Yunchi was suffering from some illness because he was in a bad mood. If that was true, then he would really not survive tonight.Thinking about it randomly, the door was knocked lightly a few times and bounced open. 339 was holding juice: "Good afternoon, would you like a refreshing summer drink?" It moved to Wen Ran. Wen Ran took the juice, hesitated for a moment, and asked: "Who is he?"Are you feeling unwell?"Well, it's been an old problem. I feel dizzy, feverish and anxious."Wen Ran said cautiously, "Is this the susceptible period?""No, the symptoms are much milder than the susceptible period. It's just a simple illness."

339 said, "The doctor has no choice but to give him some inhibitors and medicine to relieve the pain. The main thing is that he has to survive on his own." The word "suffer" immediately intensified the intensity. Seeing that Wen Ran was frightened, 339 followed suit and said, "Do you want to go and see him? He is comatose in bed now and has no one to accompany him. He is very lonely." "Is the doctor gone?" "He is gone. Generally, if there is no special situation, it is basically normal.Let him rest quietly." Wen Ran said, "Then I'd better not disturb him." "What if he wants to drink water or needs to wipe his sweat?" 339 put down the tray and showed off his stiff mechanical arm. "My hands were not flexible enough and I accidentally poured water on his face last time." After saying this, Wen Ran had no choice but to close the book and lead him outside Gu Yunchi's room.He opened the door anxiously, and all he saw was pitch black. The concentration of pheromones in the room should be very high, but Wen Ran couldn't feel it, and all he could smell was a faint fragrance.Silently, 339 quietly closed the door behind him like a ghost, and the light became darker. Wen Ran carefully walked around the partition. The room was too big, so he could only look at it - the light leaking through the gap in the curtains hit the end of the bed, with dark gray sheets, and Gu Yun lay motionless.When I walked to the bed, I heard breathing, which was not stable and a little heavy.As her eyes gradually adapted to the darkness, Wen Ran leaned over to see that Gu Yunchi was lying on his back, with the pillow supporting his fair profile and messy hair. He was so close that Wen Ran could almost feel the heat radiating from his body.Because of an accident many years ago, Gu Yunchi's pheromones have become particularly valuable, and he is also particularly picky about omega pheromones, becoming infinitely insensitive and immune. What's worse is that he can only impregnate omegas with a matching degree of more than 95%.As Gu Peiwen's most beloved and valued only grandson, Gu Yunchi naturally cannot escape the fate of being passed down as an heir. The Gu family has been looking for a highly compatible omega for him - this is all the information Wen Ran has learned.For the rest, Wen Ran had no way of knowing how the Wen family discovered this secret hidden by the Gu family, and how they obtained Gu Yunchi's pheromone report. It was only today that he learned that Gu Yunchi still had this problem in his body. S-class people were born with superior physical conditions, and even the susceptible period was rare, but he had to suffer from such a disease every once in a while. This was not a bad luck.There were medicines and water cups beside the bed. Wen Ran thought for a few seconds, then put her hand into Gu Yunchi's quilt with her wrist shaking slightly.Caught - Wen Ran was caught.The hand with a hot palm suddenly clasped his arm with shocking force. Before Wen Ran could react, he met Gu Yun's late-opened eyes in the dimness, and his scalp went numb for a moment.Before Gu Yunchi had the horrifying thought that he wanted to crawl into bed while he was sick, Wen Ran stated his intention incoherently: "No... I just want to help you take off the bracelet. It should be more comfortable if you take it off." Gu Yunchi threw away his hand in disgust, changed his sleeping position, lay on his side, and threw the removed bracelet on the quilt.Without the restraint of the bracelet, the pheromones were dissipated more unscrupulously. Wen Ran still couldn't smell it at all, but strangely felt that his glands were vaguely heated, maybe because he was too nervous."Do you want a drink of water?" Wen Ran remembered 339's instructions and asked softly, "Do you want to wipe off the sweat?" There was no answer, and he could not ask any more. Gu Yunchi even breathed impatiently.Wen Ran closed his mouth. The glands seemed to be really heating up. He wanted to touch it, but when he put his hand on it, he realized that he was still wearing a neck ring. The glands were not touched, but his fingertips touched an unknown touch button on the neck ring and made a beeping sound.Wen Ran froze immediately and stood there quietly watching the changes for nearly a minute. Nothing terrible happened. Instead, he heard that Gu Yunchi's breathing became light and even, as if he had fallen asleep peacefully.After waiting for a few more minutes and confirming that Gu Yunchi had fallen asleep, Wen Ran picked up the thermometer on the bedside table, gently reached to his ear and took the ear temperature. He still had a fever.After thinking about it, Wen Ran decided to stay and check Gu Yunchi's temperature every hour.He has selfish motives. 339 seems to have a close connection with Assistant Gu Peiwen. He might report this matter to the past. Even if he does something unnecessary, it is better than watching indifferently - Gu Yunchi and Gu Peiwen always want to please one.Throughout the afternoon, Wen Ran sat behind the door of the room. When the time came, she got up on time to take Gu Yunchi's ear temperature. The last measurement was close to normal. Wen Ran breathed a sigh of relief and sat back down. Thinking of taking a short rest, he fell asleep as soon as he closed his eyes.When I woke up, there was light in the room. Judging from the brightness, it should be the bedside lamp.Wen Ran opened his phone and took a look. It was already eight o'clock in the evening, and footsteps were heard in the room. Before he could get up from the ground, Gu Yunchi was already standing two meters away, staring at him with an unclear expression.Wen Ran heard the first words Gu Yunchi said to him in four days: "You're not leaving yet?" "Huh?" He just woke up and reacted slowly. Wen Ran thought about it for a moment and then said, "I'm worried about you. You've been having a fever." "Does it have anything to do with you?" "Because I'm tutoring at your house, so I can't be so heartless."Wen Ran couldn't see his face clearly, so he could only ask, "Are you feeling better?" "It's none of your business." Gu Yunchi said, turning around and walking to the bathroom to take a shower. He raised his hand and took off the black T-shirt he was wearing. His waist and back were exposed as the hem of the clothes moved up, and his muscle lines looked like an outstanding sketch under the light and shadow."etc!"

第4章《远方传来风笛》晚上回房间，温然特意站在房门口对比了一下，确认自己的卧室还没有顾昀迟家的玄关大。别墅应该是专门请设计师按顾昀迟的喜好装修的，冷淡又舒服的风格，没有因为面积过大而显得空旷冷清。洗完澡又做了一小时题，温然下楼倒水，正碰上陈舒茴和温睿一起回来，两人脸色都不太好，显然又争执过。温睿走过来挤开温然倒了杯水喝，温然想了想，又倒了一杯拿去给陈舒茴。“放着吧。”陈舒茴坐在沙发上看手机里的消息，温然将水杯放在茶几上，正要走，陈舒茴打着字问他，“今天去顾昀迟家怎么样？”温然说：“学到了很多知识。”陈舒茴抬起头看着他。他只好老实交代：“不怎么样。”“你这幅死气沉沉的样子，能怎么样就奇怪了。”陈舒茴又看了眼温睿，像抱怨又像自嘲，“没一个有用的。”她说着就起身上了楼，温睿不紧不慢摸出一根烟点上：“指望你去搞定顾昀迟，也不知道他们是怎么想的。”不理解他嘴里的“他们”具体指的是谁，这件事原本就是赶鸭子上架，温然问：“不然你去搞定他吗？”像自己一样，吃尽苦头植入人工腺体，带着温家对柏清集团资源和股份的觊觎，成为与顾昀迟拥有高匹配度的omega，无视对方的厌恶与冷漠，做一个没有眼色又低声下气的傻瓜——这样的苦差事，温然不认为温睿能做到。事实上也并不是能不能做到的问题，他从来没得选。与其认为当初将他直接盖章成温然是温家人对于夭折的小儿子的执念，不如说是一种先见之明，一切都像是预先写好的剧本。“我可做不来这种事，不过我倒是想看看你能怎么搞定顾昀迟。”温睿将烟头扔进垃圾桶，上楼。怎么搞定，现实是完全搞不定。去顾昀迟家的第四天，温然仍没从他那里得到任何眼神或话语，如果不是339和老师还会与他交流，他在顾昀迟家就等同于一团空气，一团每天只会说“早”和“再见，今天打扰你了”的扰人空气。连339都忍不住催他：“有没有可能其实你是NPC？怎么每天的任务和台词都是固定的，要不你找些别的话题呢？总不能一直这样下去吧！”“我在他面前变成一头驴他也不会理我的。”温然看开，“先就这样吧。”安静几秒，339问：“你真的能变成一头驴吗？”“……”早上补习结束，顾昀迟连午饭都没有吃，直接回了房间。他今天状态似乎不是特别好，上课有些没精神，而他没精神时的表情看起来格外不爽，导致温然一整个上午都战战兢兢。饭后温然和老师坐在沙发上休息看书，没过几分钟，两个医生拎着药箱走进客厅，老师对此习以为常的样子，说：“他在房间。”医生便点点头，和339一起上了楼。下午的补习只剩温然，老师给他上完课之后就先离开了：“昀迟今天应该没办法上课了，那剩下的时间你自己看书做题，有什么问题的话下周一问我。”“好，老师慢走。”独自学了近一小时，温然逐渐心不在焉，在想顾昀迟——他担心顾昀迟是不是因为心情不好而憋出了什么病，如果属实，那自己才是真的活不过今晚。乱七八糟地想着，门被轻轻敲了几下，弹开，339端着果汁：“下午好，要来一杯清爽的夏日饮品吗？”它移到温然面前，温然接过果汁，犹豫片刻，问：“他身体不舒服吗？”“嗯呢，老毛病了，时不时就这样，头晕发烧情绪焦躁。”温然语气谨慎：“是易感期吗？”“不是哦，比易感期症状轻多了，就是单纯的犯病了。”

339说，“医生也没有办法，只能给吃一点抑制剂和药缓解一下，主要还是靠他自己熬过去。”这个“熬”字顿时将程度加得很深，看温然被唬住了，339顺水推舟：“你要不要去看看他呢？他现在在床上昏迷，没有人陪，怪孤单的。”“医生走了吗？”“走了，一般没有特殊状况的话，基本是让他安静休息。”温然说：“那我还是不要去打扰他了吧。”“万一他想喝水，或者需要擦汗呢？”339放下托盘，展示了一下自己僵硬的机械手臂，“我的手不够柔软灵活，上次喂他水的时候不小心倒他脸上了，被骂死。”话已至此，温然只好合上书本，在339的带领下去了顾昀迟房外。忐忑地打开房门，目之所及是漆黑一片，房间里的信息素浓度应该很高，只是温然感知不到，能闻到的只有淡淡的香氛。无声无息的，339在背后像鬼一样悄悄把房门关上了，光线变得更暗，温然小心翼翼绕过隔断，房间太大，只能用望的——窗帘缝隙中漏进来的那道光打在床尾，深灰色床单，顾昀迟动也不动地躺着。走到床边才听见呼吸声，不太安稳也有点沉。眼睛渐渐适应黑暗，温然俯身去看，顾昀迟整个人趴着，枕头托着他白皙的侧脸和凌乱的头发，凑得近了，温然几乎能感受到他身上散发的热量。因为多年前的一场意外，顾昀迟的信息素变得尤其金贵，对omega的信息素也格外挑剔，无限趋于无感和免疫，更糟糕的是他只能使匹配度超过95%的omega怀孕。作为顾培闻最宠爱最重视的独孙，顾昀迟自然无法逃脱子嗣传承的命运，顾家一直在为他寻找高契合度omega——这是温然所了解到的全部信息。其余的，关于温家是如何发现这个被顾家隐藏的秘密，又如何拿到顾昀迟的信息素报告，温然无从得知，他也是今天才知道顾昀迟的身体还存在这种问题，s级们体质条件天生优越，连易感期都罕见，他却要隔三差五生这样的病，这何尝不是一种倒大霉。床边放着药和水杯，温然思考几秒，手腕微微抖着，伸进了顾昀迟的被子里。抓住了——是温然被抓住了。那只掌心滚烫的手猛地扣住他的手臂，力道惊人，温然还没来得及反应，就在昏暗中对上了顾昀迟睁开的眼，一瞬间头皮发麻。赶在顾昀迟认为他是想趁病爬床这个惊悚念头产生之前，温然语无伦次地道明意图：“不是……我是想帮你摘手环，摘掉了应该会舒服一点。”顾昀迟厌烦地甩开他的手，换了个睡姿，朝另一面侧躺，将摘下来的手环扔到被子上。失去手环的制约，信息素更肆无忌惮地散发，温然依旧是闻不到一点，但又奇怪地感觉到自己的腺体隐约在发热，也许是太紧张。“你要喝水吗？”温然想起339的嘱托，轻声问，“要擦汗吗？”没有回答，也不能再问下去了，顾昀迟连鼻息都透着不耐烦。温然闭上嘴，腺体似乎真的在发热，他想摸一摸，手贴上去才想到还戴着颈环，腺体是没摸到，指腹却不知碰到了颈环上的哪个触控按键，发出嘀的一声。温然顿时定住，立在原地静观其变了近一分钟，没有发生任何可怕的事，反倒听出顾昀迟的呼吸声变得轻而均匀，仿佛安稳地入睡了。又等了几分钟，确定顾昀迟是睡着了，温然拿起床头柜上的体温计，轻轻伸到他耳边，测了一下耳温，还在发烧。想了想，温然决定留下来，每隔一小时给顾昀迟测一次温度。他是有私心的，339看起来和顾培闻助理那边联系很紧密，说不定会将这件事也汇报过去，自己即使多此一举，也比冷眼旁观无动于衷来得好——顾昀迟和顾培闻，总要讨好一个。整个下午，温然靠坐在房门后，到点了便准时爬起来为顾昀迟测耳温，最后一次测量时数值已经接近正常，温然松口气，重新坐回去，想着稍微休息一下，一闭上眼却直接睡着。醒来时房间里有光亮，看亮度应该是床头灯。温然打开手机看了眼，居然已经晚上八点，而房间里正响起脚步声，不等他从地上爬起，顾昀迟已经站在两米外的位置，表情不明地盯着他。温然听到了四天以来顾昀迟对他说的第一句话：“还不走？”“啊？”刚睡醒，反应迟缓，温然回想了一下才说，“我担心你啊，你一直发烧。”“跟你有关系？”“因为我在你家补习，不能这么没有良心。”温然看不太清他的脸色，只能问，“你好点了吗？”“关你什么事。”顾昀迟说着转过身往洗手间走，去洗澡，抬手就脱身上的黑色T恤，腰和背随着衣摆上移而暴露，肌肉线条在光影下像画功出众的素描。“等等！”
